title: Probing the proton exchange kinetics of BaZr0.1Ce0.7Y0.1Yb0.1O3−δ ceramic electrolyte by operando diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform spectroscopy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05957G, Communication
Yuqing Meng, Fan Liu, Meng Li, Zixian Wang, Hao Deng, Qian Zhang, Haixia Li, Wanhua Wang, Quanwen Sun, Joshua Gomez, Zeyu Zhao, Haiyan Zhao, Dong Ding
A custom-built operando DRIFTS setup has been developed for simultaneous infrared spectroscopy and electrochemical measurements under controlled temperatures and dual gas environments.
